edits.headline: Plaid Cymru leader says party is ready to govern Wales
edits.subheadline: Plaid won 43 of the 96 seats in the Senedd election, Nation.Cymru reported.
editorialBody: Plaid Cymru leader Rhun ap Iorwerth said the party stood ready to form the next government of Wales after it won 43 of the 96 Senedd seats, Nation.Cymru reported. Reform UK won 34 seats and Labour won nine.
Elon Musk used slurs to mock French prosecutors investigating his platform X, the South China Morning Post reported.
Israel's military issued evacuation warnings for nine villages in southern Lebanon, Middle East Eye reported.
Iran said it would respond to a US proposal at the appropriate time, according to Middle East Eye.

The US sanctioned nine mainland Chinese and Hong Kong entities over alleged links to Iran's military, the South China Morning Post reported. The paper also reported that Shenzhen's Huaqiangbei electronics market was betting on AI innovations to revive its global appeal.
Scientists at BirdLife South Africa fitted trackers to seven European rollers to map their migration from Africa to Central Asia, Mongabay reported.
